findings.summary: Static, agent-visible contract limitation: place_order clearly changes state, but the host exposes no mutation annotations for either alias. Whether the gap originates at the server or host is unknown.
findings.why_it_matters: The agent cannot inspect readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, or idempotentHint to help classify placement. The reviewed-preview and confirmation boundaries remain documented.
findings.fix: Expose accurate placement annotations to the model through the server and host: readOnlyHint false, with destructiveHint and idempotentHint matching the actual placement and exact-retry behavior.

skipped_probes.reason: Partial: TASK-04 skipped because preview persistence is unknown, so it is conservatively classified write and writes are disabled. TASK-06 skipped because find_account accepts readable names, with no documented customer-ID resolver. TASK-05, TASK-07 and TASK-08 had no matching records after one retry each; no E2 inference from valid empty results.

Partial: supported narrow malformed-date validation was observed. The host rejected an out-of-range limit before server execution; no validation bypass was attempted. Omitted required fields, wrong types and enum violations were not forced. No dedicated read-by-ID/SKU-only contract was exposed; empty optional filters were not tested.

All write probes disabled by the user. preview_order conservatively classified write because persistence is unspecified; place_order classified consequential write. Neither was invoked. Preview enforcement and idempotency remain behaviorally untested.
